newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent rangebound on thin activity.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent rangebound on thin activity.

text.p: October Brent futures were untraded at midday on Monday, and were quoted within the range of London's close.
October Brent on SIMEX was quoted $18.78/$19.00 per barrel, after London on Friday ended seven cents lower at $18.99.
The weaker Brent on IPE was due to selling by players looking to make short term profits.
But brokers said that prices could move higher if they broke through the $19.00 mark, although they expected trading to be thin on SIMEX, especially with WTI also softer.
NYMEX crudes on ACCESS last traded at $19.90, down 17 cents per barrel from New York's close on Friday.
